name: bridge_project
description: Project info and config (.sbproj), file read/write, C# script create/edit/delete, hotload, input actions, and publishing metadata.

tools.name: create_script
tools.title: Create Script
tools.description: Create a new C# component script in the project â€” a minimal s&box Component class (name is sanitized to a valid identifier), or your exact code when content is provided. Errors if the file already exists. Returns { path, created, className } â€” the new type is NOT live until a recompile, so call trigger_hotload, then attach it with add_component_with_properties (component=className).

name.description: Class name for the component (e.g. 'PlayerController'). Will also be the filename.

directory.description: Subdirectory under code/ to place the script (e.g. 'Components'). Defaults to 'code/'.

description.description: Description of what this component does â€” used to generate appropriate code.

properties.description: List of [Property] fields to include in the component. JSON array.

content.description: Full C# file content. If provided, ignores name/properties and writes this directly.

tools.name: delete_script
tools.title: Delete Script
tools.description: Permanently delete a file from the project by its project-relative path (built for C# scripts, but removes any file; no recycle bin, and editor undo cannot restore it). Errors if the file doesn't exist. Returns a confirmation with the path â€” follow with trigger_hotload so the removed class actually leaves the compiled assembly.

path.description: Relative path to the script file to delete.

tools.name: describe_project
tools.title: Describe Project
tools.description: One-call project orientation: identity (name/ident/org/type), the open scene with object count, scene and prefab file lists (capped at 50 each, Libraries/.sbox excluded), code footprint (.cs/.razor counts), custom Component types (up to 100, engine types excluded), and installed libraries. Returns a structured summary â€” orient here first, then get_scene_hierarchy for the scene, describe_type for components, find_broken_references for project health. Read-only.

tools.name: edit_script
tools.title: Edit Script
tools.description: Edit an existing C# script in place via exact-text find/replace or a full-content overwrite. Errors if the file or the find text isn't found (find/replace replaces ALL occurrences). Returns { path, edited, operation } where operation is 'find_replace' or 'overwrite' â€” follow with trigger_hotload so the change compiles, then get_compile_errors if in doubt.

path.description: Relative path to the script file (e.g. 'code/PlayerController.cs').

operations.description: List of edit operations to apply in order. JSON array.

tools.name: ensure_input_action
tools.title: Ensure Input Action
tools.description: Register a custom named INPUT ACTION in the project so a generated game's custom verbs work in play mode. Writes to <project>.sbproj â†’ Metadata.InputSettings.Actions[]. Idempotent: if the action already exists it is left alone (pass update=true to rebind its key). If the project has no InputSettings yet, the full DEFAULT action set (Forward/Back/Left/Right/Jump/Use/attack1/...) is seeded first so player movement/use are preserved â€” the engine only auto-injects defaults when a game defines NONE. After adding, call it from game code with Input.Pressed("name") / Input.Down("name") / Input.Released("name"). Note: input config is read at project load, so restart_editor (or reload the project) for a new action to take effect in play mode.

name.description: The action verb game code will call, e.g. "interact", "sprint", "drop". Matches Input.Pressed("interact").

keyboardKey.description: Default keyboard binding, e.g. "e", "f", "space", "mouse1", "shift". Omit to add the action with no default key (player can bind it).

group.description: UI group the action is listed under in the bindings menu (e.g. "Actions", "Movement", "Other"). Defaults to "Actions".

update.description: If the action already exists, rebind its keyboardKey to the provided value instead of leaving it untouched. Default false (idempotent no-op when present).

tools.name: get_package_details
tools.title: Get Package Details
tools.description: Fetch package information from the s&box package backend (Package.FetchAsync) by ident. Returns { fullIdent, title, summary, description, org } â€” no download/rating/dependency data is included. Use it to confirm a package exists and what it is before install_asset.

tools.name: get_project_config
tools.title: Get Project Config
tools.description: Read the full project configuration from the .sbproj file including title, description, version, type, package references, metadata, and raw JSON.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.title: Get Project Info
tools.description: Get information about the current s&box project â€” path, name, game type, dependencies, and configuration.

tools.name: list_project_files
tools.title: List Project Files
tools.description: Browse the project file tree. Optionally filter by directory path and/or file extension (e.g. '.cs', '.scene'). Returns { path, count, files } as project-root-relative paths â€” CAPPED AT 500 files (count reflects the truncated list, with no marker that more exist), so on large projects narrow with path/extension or use find_in_project. Recursive by default.

path.description: Relative directory path to list (e.g. 'code/Components'). Defaults to project root.

extension.description: Filter by file extension, including the dot (e.g. '.cs', '.scene').

recursive.description: Whether to list files recursively. Defaults to true.

tools.name: read_file
tools.title: Read File
tools.description: Read the contents of a file in the s&box project (scripts, scenes, configs, etc.).

path.description: Relative path to the file within the project (e.g. 'code/PlayerController.cs').

tools.name: set_project_config
tools.title: Set Project Config
tools.description: Update project configuration fields for publishing: title, description, version, type, package ident, summary, visibility. Only provided fields are changed â€” edits string values in the .sbproj file in place. Returns { updated, path } (the .sbproj path); read the result back with get_project_config to confirm what actually changed.

isPublic.description: Whether the project is publicly visible.

tools.name: set_project_thumbnail
tools.title: Set Project Thumbnail
tools.description: Set or update the project thumbnail image (thumb.png) used for publishing. Provide either a source path or base64 image data.

sourcePath.description: Relative path to an image file within the project to use as thumbnail.

base64.description: Base64-encoded image data to write as thumbnail.

format.description: Image format when using base64 mode. Defaults to 'png'. One of: png | jpg.

tools.name: trigger_hotload
tools.title: Trigger Hotload
tools.description: Nudge s&box to recompile and hotload the project's C# (bumps the .csproj timestamps the file-watcher keys on). NOT synchronous: the compile lands on a later frame, and editing an EXISTING .cs can leave the OLD assembly running silently. Returns { triggered, touched, assemblyBefore, note } â€” assemblyBefore is the current game-assembly fingerprint; poll get_bridge_status.gameAssembly until it differs (or verify with an explicit marker such as a version string in a Log.Info) BEFORE trusting invoke_button / describe_type output. Falls back to restart_editor for new package dependencies.

tools.name: write_file
tools.title: Write File
tools.description: Write or overwrite a file in the s&box project (SILENTLY replaces existing content â€” read_file first if you need to preserve it). Creates parent directories as needed; paths are confined to the project root (traversal outside it is denied). Returns a confirmation with the path â€” for C# follow with trigger_hotload so it compiles; for assets (.vmat etc.) follow with recompile_asset.

content.description: The full file content to write.
